title: Certification of PGD reduced-order models with separated spatial variables
summary: Model order reduction techniques have become an attractive approach for obtaining fast approximations of multidimensional problems. Besides computational efficiency, ensuring the reliability of the resulting approximations is of primary importance. This work focuses on the certification of PGD-based reduced-order models based on the separation of spatial variables, which are particularly well suited to plate and shell geometries. Considering diffusion problems defined in plate-like domains, we introduce a guaranteed global error estimate associated with the PGD approximation. To this end,…
